preconditions.description: The number of distinct integers is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The total points Bimokh can score is at least 0 and at most 10^8.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.split() == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10^9 for x in output.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a sequence of n distinct integers, each at most 10^9.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or sum(gcd(int(output.split()[i]), int(output.split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1)) == k
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the sum of gcd of each pair of adjacent integers in the output sequence equals k.

invariants.description: There is at least one integer in the sequence.
The number of integers in the sequence is at most 10^5.
The total points Bimokh can score is at least 0.
The total points Bimokh can score is at most 10^8.
